summary: Independently checked all five proposed facts against their complete canonical citations. Back bypass, cached commit ordering, two-column navigation and shared frequency corrections are supported; functionality agrees. Retain inherited supported names and unchanged knowledge. Compiled-layout, scheduler/lifetime and exceptional-state uncertainties remain deferred rather than inferred safe.

proposed_facts.reason: Canonical declarations, display publication, startup and entry completion establish the pointer and gate roles. Back returns before the gate check; the correction does not assert compiled size or adjacency.

Input dispatch confirms Back priority, the ordinary-index A branch, Start as an else-if, and special-index A fallthrough to directions. A saves cached items; the visual callback separately updates the ordinary cache. Scheduler-dependent persistence remains appropriately deferred.
Navigation cycles and cursor placement establish two visual columns, 31 ordinary entries, a clamped cross-column transition, and two positions sharing the six-valued frequency control.
All numeric mask priorities, exceptional transitions, frequency wraps and destination-cache loads match the canonical branches. Geometry varies Y within each column rather than X within rows.
Selection feedback handles individual item animations and cursor placement; both special positions animate jobjs[3] and synchronize x21. The correction does not imply two independent settings.

Accept supersession of fact:3a3c066b-d92b-48c5-869f-9a73d0fdd837: A suppresses Start even at special positions, and ordinary cache synchronization is separate from A's cached commit.

Accept supersession of fact:5ecf46dd-555b-4e2f-af85-64d39410ae57 and fact:2bb4bd1f-8f20-4cf7-901e-666eddcd43c5: two-column geometry contradicts the prior row-based interpretation; numeric transitions preserve the exact behavior.
Accept supersession of fact:001a3193-cee5-4c8d-8a9d-ae0ac3a29397: both special positions address the same frequency animation and cached value.

unresolved.details: Accept inherited deferral of section size, padding, literal-pool emission and aggregate-overlay adjacency. Source declarations and comments are insufficient.

Accept inherited deferrals: special-to-ordinary movement can consume anim_val without its ordinary-old-cursor assignment, and transition animation selection relies on incompletely established state invariants. No compiled behavior or safe default is inferred.

unresolved.issue: Cross-file destruction and scheduling remain deferred.
unresolved.details: Display removal precedes text-pointer reads; user data has an HSD_Free destructor; text pointers are initialized after entry completion; Back bypasses the gate. These observations do not independently establish destruction timing or a runtime bug. Separate input and visual callbacks also prevent treating an ordinary A toggle as atomically persisted.

unresolved.issue: Inherited header rendering limitation remains open.
